ATTACKS TRIED: 15 (A1–A15), 11 survived, 4 reproduced breaks.
- Survived (VERIFIED, test passes on candidate): A1 3-way concurrent consumption spends exactly 2 distinct tickets, 3rd gets offline.allocation_exhausted; A2 same operationId submitted twice concurrently → 1 receipt, 1 decrement, one replayed=true; A3 account switch between the ticket UPDATE and the receipt INSERT → DataOwnerChangedError, full rollback (2 spendable, 0 receipts, 0 consumed rows), other owner sees empty wallet; A4 account switch while receipts are in flight → offline.receipt_unknown, nothing settled for either owner, receipt still pending with settlement NULL; A5 crash between two verdict writes → first accepted, second stays queued and is the ONLY receipt re-presented on the next drain, tickets never returned; A6 receipts route answering 429+Retry-After, 503, 302 redirect, 401, and a hung request aborted at API_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS (network.timeout) → typed ApiError, every receipt stays queued, allocation unchanged; A15 six malformed verdict batches (duplicate id, missing id, extra id, receipt both recorded and rejected, unknown status, numeric status / null id) → network.invalid_response, zero settlements; A7 lease bound exactly 7d accepted / 7d+1s offline.grant_invalid, consumption at exp*1000-1 active and at exp*1000 offline.grant_expired, far-past (0), far-future (MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), rollbackDetected and floor-authority readings all refuse without spending; A10 newer generation arriving before the older one → older holds 0, spendable 2 (not 4), both spends land on gen2, every grantId variant then exhausted, 2 receipts; A11 replay of an operation whose receipt was refused returns the refused receipt (replayed=true) and spends nothing; A14 one unreadable receipt row → offline.wallet_corrupt from pendingOfflineReceipts and reconcile with fetch never called, consumed ticket not resurrected, replay of that operation refused as corrupt.
- Breaks (test FAILS on candidate): A9 (P2) refused+restated ticket stranded (spendable 1 vs 2); A8 (P3) NaN nowMs → active/consumed; A12 (P3) tampered allocated_ticket_ids + forged ticket row → spendable 3, forged ticket consumed; A13 (P3) tampered expires_at extends execution past signed exp. No P0/P1: no double-spend, no over-charge, no cross-owner leak, no fabricated empty state found. A9 is INFERRED on server restatement semantics (server issue_offline_grant not in this package); the tampering breaks require local DB write access and the device does not verify the grant signature at all (documented residual), so they are tamper-evidence gaps rather than a spend the server would honour.

implement.approach: Regression suite first (commit f30ad1e2), then implementation (commit 7ec8d097). offlineCapabilities.ts replaces the static capability map with an active wallet: OFFLINE_WALLET_DDL (offline_grant, offline_ticket, offline_receipt), holdOfflineGrant() validating the compact JWS claims against the owner/installation binding and de-duplicating ticket ids through a per-owner global offline_ticket ledger keyed (owner_key, ticket_id) — a restated generation moves a still-remaining ticket forward and never resurrects a consumed one; consumeOfflineAllocation() evaluates the lease with evaluateLease() under TrustedTimeReading, flips exactly one ticket remaining→consumed and inserts the receipt in the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, and checks operationId replay before selecting a ticket (identical binding → idempotent original receipt; different resultId/fullOutputSha256/grant binding → OfflineGrantError offline.receipt_conflict, nothing spent); settleOfflineReceipt() treats 'held' as non-terminal (settled_at NULL, still in pendingOfflineReceipts(), later accepted/refused recorded); readOfflineAllocation() reports remaining = distinct unconsumed tickets; corrupt/unknown rows throw offline.wallet_corrupt rather than reading as an empty wallet; nothing ever re-adds capacity on disconnect, restart, reinstall, expiry or ambiguous settlement. api.ts (additive only, no existing symbol changed — verified `git diff` has zero removed lines) adds OfflineGrantClient with registerDevice/requestGrant on the actual Edge routes POST /v1/devices/register and POST /v1/offline/grants, plus submitReceipts() for POST /v1/offline/receipts with an all-or-nothing verdict parser (every submitted id exactly once, no unknown ids, malformed/un-coded answers → 502 network.invalid_response, nothing settled). reconcileOfflineReceipts() settles receipts only from a complete verdict set. Shipping wiring stays inside the mobile-data group: db.ts applies the DDL, syncRuntime.ts drains queued receipts after every outbox drain and backs off while any receipt is pending. apps/mobile/src/analysis/runCaptureAnalysis.ts (mobile-analysis group, not held) was NOT edited; the capability map states explicitly that the rated-run flow still authorises through the online permit and does not yet spend from the held wallet.
out_of_scope_files: apps/mobile/src/data/db.ts — additive: import OFFLINE_WALLET_DDL and spread it into LOCAL_MIGRATIONS so the wallet tables exist in the shipping SQLite database (2 lines; under the mobile-data serial group this package holds).

apps/mobile/src/data/syncRuntime.ts — additive wiring: build createOfflineGrantClient(apiConfig) and call reconcileOfflineReceipts(db, offlineGrants, await trustedTime.read()) after each drainOutbox, counting pending receipts toward the retry backoff (under the mobile-data serial group this package holds). This is the shipping code path that presents durably queued receipts.

apps/mobile/__harness__/serverResponseMatrix/outboxFakeDb.ts — 1 line: the in-memory outbox fake (test-only harness, not under any serial group) answers `SELECT * FROM offline_receipt` with no rows, exactly as it already does for analysis_run_journal/analysis_execution_attempts reads, because syncRuntime now reads the wallet after every drain. No test assertion changed; without it __tests__/wf/be-mobile-sync-outbox.test.ts throws `unhandled sql` and its cadence assertions fail.

residual_risks: UNKNOWN/INFERRED: the production Edge function (supabase/functions/api/index.ts, edge-index serial group — forbidden for this package) does not serve POST /v1/offline/receipts; its `default:` branch returns a 404 envelope without a verdict code. The mobile client treats that as an unreadable answer (502 network.invalid_response), settles nothing, and keeps every receipt queued (pinned by the test 'reconciliation refuses unreadable answers and a missing route'). Until the receipts route ships, a device that has consumed a wallet ticket will re-present its receipts on every drain and the sync timer will back off (max backoff) while receipts stay pending. Follow-up package needed on the Edge side.

This package delivers the wallet, its durability semantics, and the shipping receipt drain inside mobile-data; the capability map states this limitation explicitly. A follow-up in mobile-analysis must route the offline branch of the scoring flow through the wallet — that group was not granted to this package and I did not edit it.

implement.summary: Defect on BASE_SHA 674bcacc: apps/mobile/src/data/offlineCapabilities.ts is a static capability map only (no grant storage, no consumption, no receipts) and apps/mobile/src/data/api.ts has no offline grant/receipt client, so nothing on the device can hold a server-issued grant, decrement allocation on consumption or queue a receipt — the 28-test regression suite fails 28/28 there (createOfflineGrantClient is not a function). Round-2 candidate (branch devin/pp/w04-05/impl-r2, head 7ec8d097716ec08a6472462771be2d10d4821dd9, two commits: f30ad1e2 tests, 7ec8d097 implementation) reuses the sound parts of impl-r1 and resolves every prior finding: (1) P0 cross-generation restatement — offline_ticket is a per-owner global ledger keyed by ticket id, restated generations move remaining copies forward and never resurrect consumed tickets, readOfflineAllocation() never reports more spendable tickets than distinct unconsumed ids, and consumption cannot spend a ticket twice across generations (tests 'ticket ids are conserved across grant generations'); (2) P1 'held' is non-terminal — settled_at stays NULL, the receipt remains in pendingOfflineReceipts() and later accepted/refused is recorded; (3) P1 conflicting replay — a reused operationId with a different resultId/fullOutputSha256/grant binding throws OfflineGrantError offline.receipt_conflict and spends nothing, identical replay stays idempotent; (4) reviewer blocking 'no shipping path calls the wallet' — within the held mobile-data group, db.ts applies OFFLINE_WALLET_DDL and syncRuntime.ts drains queued receipts after every outbox drain through the additive OfflineGrantClient.submitReceipts() with an all-or-nothing verdict parser, backing off while receipts stay pending. The rated-run flow itself (apps/mobile/src/analysis, mobile-analysis group not granted) is intentionally untouched and the capability map states it still authorises via the online permit; the Edge function does not yet serve POST /v1/offline/receipts (edge-index group forbidden), and the client keeps every receipt queued when that route answers 404 — both recorded as residual risks / follow-ups.
